text:
maya: Heads-up — we're seeing a spike of NVIDIA Xid 79 on a10-pool-3 since ~03:10 UTC. ~40 errors/min, some inference jobs restarted. Anyone on call?

kevin: I see the alert. Any recent deploys to embedder-v2 or batch-queue changes?

ashley: deploy-bot: release/embedded/2026-03-18-embedder-v2 deployed to us-west2 at 03:08 UTC (sha: c3f8a4). No driver/kernel changes in the release.

dmitri: Xid 79 often maps to ECC/unrecovered memory on A10s but can also be driver/kernel interactions. What's the workload pattern — long sequence lengths or unusually large batches?

maya: embedder-v2 ramped sequence length cap to 8192 for a subset of tenants and switched to continuous batching last night; KV cache retention also increased.

kevin: pulling logs from node a10-3-27: 
```
[03:11:02] nvml: Xid 79: PTE corruption detected on GPU 0
[03:11:02] kernel: NVRM: GPU Xid: 79
[03:11:05] nvidia-smi stats: temp=86C, memory-used=12.3GiB, ecc-uncorrected=1
```

dmitri: temp 86C is high but not immediate thermal shutdown. ECC uncorr=1 is the red flag. Can you paste `nvidia-smi -q -d ECC` and `dmesg | grep -i nvrm`?

maya: ran `nvidia-smi -q -d ECC` -> shows 1 uncorr ECC on GPU0. dmesg has repeated lines: `NVRM: Xid 79` and `EEC memory error` about GPU 0000:3b:00.0.

ops-runbook-bot: Xid-79 triage steps (short):
1) Mark impacted tenant jobs and drain node
2) Run gpu memtest / cuda_memtest on the card
3) Reproduce with synthetic kv-cache heavy load (batch-size + seq)
4) Check driver version and GPU firmware; if ECC uncorr > 0 -> schedule RMA/replace
Runbook: https://runbooks/redwood/xid-79

ashley: draining a10-3-27 now. `/drain a10-3-27 --reason "Xid79 ECC=1"` :thumbsup:  Jobs will be rescheduled to a10-pool-3 spares.

kevin: queuing repro on spare a10-3-31 with pattern: batch=64, seq=8192, kv-retention=90%. If we repro Xid79 we'll label the card flaky and escalate.

dmitri: also check firmware — vendor reported A10 fw v2.1.4 had a large GEM mapping bug that can surface as Xid79 with big KV allocations. Driver matrix: if using < 530.x consider upgrading to 545.x which has several Xid-related fixes.

maya: memtest in progress (cuda_memtest run). If memtest fails we'll open hardware ticket.

kevin: operational decision: if memtest fails or we see >1 uncorr ECC -> immediate RMA/replace. Otherwise keep under observation and throttle sequence length to 4096 for embedder-v2 until we clear.

sre-bot: alert-suppression: suppress noisy Xid79 alerts for a10-pool-3 for 2h while drain/replace is in progress.

maya: noted — will post memtest result and wave on RMA. tagging @dmitri for firmware/drivers follow-up.

ashley: FYI: tenant-42 saw 5 request retries before failover; we've increased retry budget for short window to reduce end-user errors.

dmitri: after replacement, capture `nvidia-smi -q`, `dmesg` + a 30m synthetic run and also snapshot driver + fw versions in the hardware ticket.

maya: thanks all. follow-up: memtest failed -> will open HW ticket and schedule swap today. :white_check_mark:
